summary.intent: Finish the pre-release downgrade fix (PR #538) and then reproduce and fix the remaining changelog findings from the bug hunt, namely incomplete or stale 'Dependency updates' entries in cascaded packages' changelogs.
summary.outcome: PR #538 was marked ready for review. A second branch, fix/changelog-dependency-updates, now records every bumped dependency per consumer in cascade and lists each at the version it actually reached. It has a regression test and a changeset, and was committed signed, pushed and linked to trail #357. The PR number was queried but not shown, and the `pre exit` dependency-line loss was not addressed.

repo: Pre-release downgrade fix lives in `versioned_bump` in groups.rs; if the bump lands behind the live version, severity is raised until it doesn't, otherwise the existing version-regression error is raised.

Changelog 'Dependency updates' entries previously came from a single BumpReason::Cascade reason, which only held the first via dependency. They now come from CascadeOutcome::dependency_updates (consumer -> bumped dependency -> DepKind).

Changelog entries are built in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs through map_reason_to_change_source plus the new dependency_update_entries helper, which reads versions from outcome.targets.
Checks are run via `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, and `just workflow-contracts`. Commits are signed with `-S` and branches are linked to trail issues via `entire trail link`.
Changes need a changeset file in .changeset/.

code.finding: CascadeOutcome gained a `dependency_updates: BTreeMap<PackageId, BTreeMap<PackageId, DepKind>>` field. It is populated when an edge is rewritten or its dependency severity is greater than None.
BumpReason::Cascade now maps to None in map_reason_to_change_source, because dependency_update_entries adds the entries in both the aggregate and per-package changelog paths.

workflow: Reproduce agent-reported bugs against the real binary before fixing them, instead of trusting the report.
Python string-replace patch scripts needed manual follow-up edits when the replaced block's tail was left inconsistent.
Start fix branches from origin/main with --no-track, one PR per finding group.

friction: The scripted multi-line replacement in version.rs left the block tail broken and had to be fixed by hand.
The first regression test failed to compile because of a type mismatch (to.render() returned a borrowed value). It took two sed/edit passes to fix.
The work happens in a worktree still holding the earlier #537 branch, so branch state has to be watched.
open_items: The `pre exit` dependency-line loss finding is not yet fixed or reproduced.
The stale-version finding was only partly covered; the new entries use the version actually reached, but the repro result was not shown in detail.
`just workflow-contracts` has not been run, and CI has not run on either PR.
The PR number for fix/changelog-dependency-updates was not displayed, so the PR may still need to be opened or edited.
The old pre-mode test expectation was changed from 1.1.0-next.0 to 2.0.0-next.1 with no recorded decision behind the old behaviour, so the user may want to confirm.
